excluded_from_first_round.reason: Duplicates of the 5 selected topics (5 variants per topic from 5 content-pack runs). 20 X posts + 20 blog drafts remain in raw queue and will be re-evaluated in subsequent rounds if human publishing of the first round is successful.

post_text_passthrough_disclaimer: All post_text fields in shortlists are VERBATIM copies of the corresponding x-post.zh.md in content-packs. Phase 6C did NOT rewrite, summarize, or re-generate any post text. No LLM call was made.

human_action_required: Review each ready_x item for tone, accuracy, and brand alignment before any manual post.
Post manually via baoyu-post-to-x or direct Twitter UI. Do NOT automate.
If a topic is rejected during review, mark it as 'human_rejected' in a future phase; do not auto-substitute.
no_human_action_required: Do NOT call any model (image, video, music, LLM).
Do NOT publish to X, Twitter, blog, or any platform.
Do NOT start any timer or cron job.
Do NOT modify systemd, gateway, or .env files.
Do NOT overwrite daily-digest.md, telegram-digest.txt, or status.json.
